title: Visit list values
summary: Go: Visit list values. Add fish to the slice.
introduction: range gives an index and a value for each slice item. _ ignores the index.

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Visit list values

blocks.text: range supplies an index and item. _ ignores the index; pet receives each word.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A single range variable is the index, not the value.
